notes: Identity independently checked: title, seven named authors, 2024 volume 20(1), DOI 10.20982/tqmp.20.1.r001 and terminal citation match the supplied Couture et al. reference. This is the primary replication report, with Methods, Results and Discussion for Experiments 1–5, not an abstract-only excerpt or a preregistration. No PDF supplied. Original side and unassigned fields are placeholders, not re-extracted. Experiment 1 word-length main effect is described as detected but smaller; General Discussion limits its presence mainly to similar words. Abstract gives an overall non-replication verdict for word length across experiments. The mixed code preserves that qualification. Printed p < .001 is retained as printed in evidence despite the accompanying F statistic; no correction made.
